title: Semantics Preserving Emoji Recommendation with Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing per-class classification accuracy in a downstream gender prediction task, revealing that the models' accuracy on the female class consistently surpasses that of the male class when evaluating recommended emojis.

Evaluating downstream classification accuracy across different age groups (child, teen, adult, senior) based on the recommended emojis, identifying significant performance disparities such as notably lower accuracy for the senior class.

Analyzing per-class accuracy in sentiment and emotion classification tasks to identify models' tendencies to default to prevalent or heuristic classes (e.g., happiness over disgust, or positive/negative over neutral) when predicting contextually appropriate emojis.
